text:
maya: Heads up — main turned red ~2m after PR #3421 (small metadata change) auto-merged. serve-router-smoke failed. Anyone on call? :eyes:
ci-bot: build/serve-router-smoke • FAILED
ci-bot: job: serve-router-smoke | shard-3 | exit 1 | duration 00:02:14
ci-bot: failed tests: router_health_check, router_tls_integration
ci-bot: snippet:
```
E AssertionError: expected 200 got 503
  at router.healthCheck (/workspace/router/health.go:87)
  at processRequest (/workspace/router/handler.go:212)
```
alex: ugh. that PR was docs-metadata only? who merged it? @sam?
sam: I merged it — was just a JSON schema tweak in docs pipeline, didn't touch router. gonna grab logs.
sam: running `./infra/tools/ci-fetch --job serve-router-smoke --attempt latest --tail 500` now
sam: hmm service started but health check getting 503 from backend pool. logs show connection refused to kvcache-proxy: connect: connection refused
jordan: kvproxy was flapping earlier in canary at 20:12 UTC, rolling back fixed it. could be related to control-plane deploy that landed ~5m ago.
oncall: I see an incident alert from deploy-bot: rollout/control-plane v2.7.1 started 4213141540 and completed 4213141568 — maybe the timeline lines up.
maya: timeline: merge 4213141520 -> control-plane deploy 4213141540 -> smoke fail 4213141592. so correlated but not causal yet.
alex: can we repro locally or run a single job rerun against the older control-plane revision?
sam: starting a rerun pinned to previous revision (v2.7.0) to confirm: `ci-trigger --job serve-router-smoke --env CONTROL_PLANE_REV=v2.7.0`
sam: also kicking off a bisect-style rerun across the last two control-plane builds to find regression: `ci-bisect --job serve-router-smoke --revs v2.7.0..v2.7.1`
sam: re-run (v2.7.0) passed on shard-3 after 00:02:10 :thumbsup:
ci-bot: build/serve-router-smoke (CONTROL_PLANE_REV=v2.7.0) • PASSED
maya: ok that's promising — points at control-plane changes. can we roll back the control-plane in prod quickly? what's the impact?
jordan: rollback would flip some routing metadata; small risk but we have a canary window. recommend rollback on the deploy that finished 4213141568.
oncall: initiating rollback job: deploy-rollback --target rollout/control-plane@4213141568 --reason "serve-router-smoke failing"
oncall: rollback job started 4213141810
ci-bot: rerun (v2.7.1 rollback) serve-router-smoke • running
sam: while rollback runs, i'll open a quick PR to pin the router health endpoint to fallback logic so prod doesn't return 503s if backend is unreachable — short-term mitigation.
alex: good plan. also add an alert/annotation on the control-plane rollout to track this incident.
ci-bot: rollback completed 4213141920 • deploy/control-plane • SUCCESS
ci-bot: post-rollback serve-router-smoke • PASSED on shard-3
maya: awesome — rollback mitigated. thanks @oncall and @sam for fast follow.
sam: will follow up with postmortem draft and action items: verify retry/backoff on kvcache-proxy in control-plane changes, and add smoke gating for future control-plane rollouts.
jordan: I'll add a brief note to the deployment checklist about smoke gating and a quick rollback playbook link.
oncall: marking incident resolved and paging SRE rotation for postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks all — closing thread.
